name: Word montage
summary: Rapid-fire display words, one per beat, with outlined echoes above and below and an optional mini card per word (built by a caller function). Entrances alternate zoom, right, left, up; each word exits toward the next entrance; the last word pushes into a hard cut. Give each word about 0.9 s or more.

params.items: [{ word, at, mode?: 'zoom'|'right'|'left'|'up', card?: (cardEl, ctx) => void, maxSize? }]
params.end: time of the hard cut after the last word
params.pace: { enter, exit, stagger, accent } overrides for the PACE timings (seconds)

usage:
import * as montage from '../blocks/word-montage/index.mjs';
const words = montage.create(ctx, { items: [{ word: 'Stream.', at: CUE.w1, card: (el) => buildWaiverRow(el) }], end: CUE.next });
changelog: v1 2026-09-26: extracted from the DraftKit showreel stream/sit/trade montage

v2 2026-09-26: readable pacing. Transitions use PACE (entrances about 0.5 s, exits about 0.4 s, staggers about 0.14 s) with a `pace` override, cues.out means fully gone, and default cues and the demo leave time to read.
